title: Breeze Dark's color pallet isn't consistent
line: With the Breeze Dark colors, popup headers no longer get darker when the Plasma style is switched from Breeze to Breeze Dark.
explanation: Plasma styles that ship their own colors file (Breeze Dark, Breeze Light) colour their SVGs from KSvg's ImageSet instead of from Kirigami's colours. In that path every FrameSvgItem stayed on the Window colour set (its colorSet is no longer settable from QML), and ColorScheme-Background always used the Window colours anyway, so PlasmoidHeading headers got the Window background instead of the Header one and looked darker than with the Breeze style. FrameSvgItem now takes its colour set from its Kirigami.Theme, and the Background colour follows that set like the text colours already did.

commits.message:
FrameSvgItem: follow the Kirigami color set with themes that have colors

With a Plasma style that ships its own colors file, frame SVGs always
used the Window colors, so headers were darker than with the same scheme
and a style without colors. Use the item's Kirigami color set there too.

BUG: 525075

media.caption: Master, Breeze Dark colors: system tray popup with the Breeze style (left) and the Breeze Dark style (right); the header is darker on the right
With the fix: same popup with the Breeze style (left) and the Breeze Dark style (right); the headers match

review.text: Finds the real cause in KSvg: with styles that ship a colors file, FrameSvgItem stayed on the Window color set and ColorScheme-Background ignored the color set entirely. Making the item follow its Kirigami colorSet (the enum orders match) and using the current scheme for Background like Text already does is the right place and the smallest change. The header pixel values match between the two styles after the fix, with no visible change in Kickoff or the calendar, and the autotest adjustment is justified.
